ocv-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Aguas Claras Airport (OCV) lies among town, farmland and vegetation.

ocv-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 白色弧形屋顶的航站楼正面写着阿瓜斯克拉拉斯机场的名字，门前列着一排开花的盆栽。
ocv-chatgpt-01.webp.en: The curved white roof of the terminal carries the name Aeropuerto Aguas Claras Ocaña, with flowering planters along the front and a deep blue sky above.

ocv-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 黑色与黄蓝红三色旗帜在航站楼前的旗杆上飘动，路缘刷着黄黑相间的警示条纹。
ocv-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Two flags flutter on poles before the terminal, one dark and one in yellow, blue and red, above a kerb painted with yellow and black stripes.

ocv-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 棕榈树的枝叶下，一架灰色大型军用运输机停在停机坪上，白色塔台立在一旁，远处是青山。
ocv-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Through palm fronds, a large grey military transport aircraft stands on the apron beside a white control tower, with green hills beyond.

ocv-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 湿润的沥青跑道上，一架白色双发涡桨飞机正在滑行，身后是云雾缭绕的绿色群山。
ocv-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A white twin turboprop moves along the wet runway, framed by tall dry grass in front and cloud-wrapped green mountains behind.
